sections.heading: What does this client need?
sections.text:
10 · What to use when: a decision map
Start with where the client is, then refine with what you learn. Every answer is a real asset from section 2, a step we proposed in product scoping, or a gap.

sections.heading: Refine by what you learn
sections.text:
Brands
Single brand: Starter Pack, brand as a mode
Brand + sub-brands: Configurator + Figma plugin
Multi-brand: AJIO + Starter Pack brands
Client brands stay in client workspaces
Platforms
One breakpoint set: Starter Pack
Multi-breakpoint web: Starter Pack + DSN page templates
Web + native: AJIO (React + React Native)
Tokens transfer, components don’t
Native only: Ajman Bank (Flutter)
Products
One: Starter Pack
Several sharing a system: a product layer, not a fork
Portfolio, different needs: Vorwerk (3 libraries → 1)
Theming
1–2 modes: Configurator
3+ modes: Starter Pack library + plugin
Check their Figma plan’s mode limit
Design tokens
None: Starter Pack
Tokens, no Figma variables: Figma plugin pushes them in
Figma variables, no tokens: Configurator export
Both, in sync: DSN audits in CI
Both, drifted: Path B scan + 3-way review
Decide which side leads first
Figma components
None: Starter Pack Figma library
Unmanaged: Path B assessment
Published library: map it with the Figma plugin
Variants + props: Code Connect (DSN: 90 mapped)
Coded components
None: Starter Pack
In-app only: Gap: extraction playbook
Shared library: Code Connect
Versioned package: DSN npm + MCP, llms.txt
Code stack
Plain React + CSS: Starter Pack fits as is
Tailwind / shadcn: Gap: Tailwind theme output
MUI / Ant: Gap: theme adapter
Theme their library, don’t replace it
React Native: AJIO case
Angular / Vue: Gap: tokens and rules only
Flutter / iOS / Android: Ajman Bank case (Flutter)
Governance
Dedicated DS team: DSN skills + CI checks
One part-time owner: Handbook: automate the checks
Nobody: Name an owner first
Docs & tooling
Storybook: Starter Pack Storybook + a11y gate
Docs platform: Gap: zeroheight export
Tokens Studio: AJIO uses it; Gap: Tokens Studio import
Accessibility
Not stated: Set WCAG AA by default
WCAG AA target: Starter Pack a11y gate
Regulated (EAA): DSN a11y skill; Gap: EAA report template
AI readiness
No AI tooling: Configurator agent, live
Licences, not machine-readable: DSN index + MCP
Licences + AI-ready: Evals + agent governance
Our AI layer is table stakes
Legacy
Greenfield: Path A · Start new
Replacing an old system: Path B · Bring your system
Old and new coexist: DS Scale; Gap: migration playbook
